title: The standard loading indicator shows on load and reload, rows swap only when data returns, and the toolbar stays interactive
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Technician Utilization report with rows loaded.
custom_steps:
1. Watch the data area during the initial load.
2. Change the date range and watch the data area during the reload.
3. While it loads, try interacting with a toolbar control.
custom_expected:
1. On the initial load and on every reload (date-range or location change), the data area shows the standard reports loading indicator.
2. The existing rows are replaced only when the new data returns.
3. The toolbar remains interactive during the load.
